cārudassana.p: [Cāru+dassana] (ti) CL=10 Cārudassanā; Cārudassanī (Thī).] (1) A person with a beautiful complexion. (2) Has pretty eyes; A person. (3) Having a good complexion just like a golden complexion; A person.

စာရုဒဿန（တိ）
[cāru+dassana．thī-nitea cārudassanā，cārudassanī．]

cārudassana：စာရုဒဿန （တိ）

Ap 90, 11 (~o va sobhāmi, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se catuvaṇṇāya; Ap-a 366, 35 foll. : suvaṇṇavaṇṇo iva sobhāmī ti virocāmī ti attho, catuvaṇṇehi sobhāmī ti pi pāṭho, Be, Se so; Ce catuvaṇṇāya; Ee catuvaṇṇo); — sucāru , mfn. , very beautiful ; Pv 24:11 (tato tuvaṃ aṅgapaccaṅgā ~ū piyadassanā); — ~-rūpa, mfn. , very pleasing, absolutely beautiful ; Ap 272, 8 (~-rūpaṃ disvāna; Ap-a 310, 3 foll. : sundaraṃ cāruṃ manohararūpavantaṃ … sambuddhaṃ disvā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee sundaraṃ ~uṃ); 310, 10 (~-rūpo … homi); — ~rūpaṃ, adv. , in a very pleasing or splendid way ;? S I 181, 2* (~rūpaṃ vata bhikkhu jhāyasi; Spk I 265, 9 : atisundaraṃ vata jhānaṃ jhāyasī ti vadati).
